description: OpenNEM Facilities is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by OpenNEM. Open Platform for National Electricity Market Data interactive map of facilities and generator capacity. The map uses public National Electricity Market (NEM) data and provides it in an accessible format. This project is part of the University of Melbourne’s Climate and Energy College “Live-Emission tracker” project under the Energy Transition Hub. Coverage is the states and territories; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as continuous (live), the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: Report (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
